title: Troubleshooting Dropped Calls
problem: Customer is experiencing frequent dropped calls.
escalation_condition: If the issue continues after troubleshooting, escalate to network support.

title: Troubleshooting Slow Mobile Data
problem: Customer is experiencing slow mobile internet or data connectivity.
escalation_condition: If mobile data remains slow after troubleshooting, escalate to network support.

title: Troubleshooting Poor Network Reception
problem: Customer is experiencing weak or poor network reception.
steps: Move to an area with better signal coverage
escalation_condition: If poor reception continues, investigate possible network coverage issues or escalate to network support.

title: Network Issue Escalation
problem: Customer continues to experience network problems after standard troubleshooting.
symptoms: Standard troubleshooting has not resolved the issue
steps: Confirm that standard troubleshooting has been attempted
Escalate the issue to network support
escalation_condition: Escalate when the issue persists after standard troubleshooting.
